name: Snipe Laser
doc: Snipe Laser (GIM47N's attack; a Funguar laser variant): the master and the beam tasks - two beams from two points of the caster's skeleton to each target: the aim layouts, the beams, the hit layouts and glows, beam 0's impact layout and sparks, the sound; the action results. Its tasks are the port's code (FFNx mag302_snipe_laser.cpp) run on the program's memory (its pools and packet arenas in the magic buffer).

copy.doc: Where this effect's copy is in FF8_EN.exe: the program stands in for these functions.

module.doc: The port module whose code runs: its memory [from, + size) - in a copy, a block of its own.

exe_data.doc: The exe data the effect uses (@key in its values).

director.doc: The port's file loader, setup and root (they start its tasks)

parts.title: Beam
parts.doc: Two beams from two points of the caster's skeleton to each target: the aim layouts, the beams, the hit layouts and glows, beam 0's impact layout and sparks, the sound; the action result at beam 0's 0x2B

params.label: Hit
params.doc: The prim-model layout hit (its models' animation)

params.label: Muzzle
params.doc: The prim-model layout muzzle (its models' animation; decoded into each beam, never played: no change shows)

params.label: Ray
params.doc: The prim-model layout ray (its models' animation)

params.label: Impact
params.doc: The prim-model layout impact (its models' animation)

params.label: Spark
params.doc: The sprite sequence spark (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Glow
params.doc: The sprite sequence glow (a flipbook of 16 frames: an edited one keeps as many)

params.label: Beam model
params.doc: The prim model beam (a mesh of 220 vertices, 160 primitives: an edited one keeps its vertices (its code reads them by number))

params.label: Texture file
params.doc: The texture file its loader reads from the magic folder (a name of at most 31 letters)

params.label: Camera track
params.doc: The camera track its setup plays (any length: its offsets are its own)

params.label: Beam points
params.doc: Where each beam starts: a point (x, y, z) and the caster's bone it is on, beam 0 then beam 1 (16 bytes: an edited one keeps its length)
